take: Winnipeg announced it recalled center Brayden Yager from Manitoba (AHL), placed defenseman Josh Morrissey on injured reserve and put right wing Walker Duehr on waivers. Morrissey has missed four games already, and the Jets have been 4-2-2 overall; when he plays, their share of the quality chances (expected goals) rises by about four points. In his absence, Mario Ferraro has moved in beside DeMelo, Neal Pionk has taken Morrissey's first power-play spot, and Tyrel Bauer is up to 9:44 a night from 7:17. The site has no numbers on Yager or Duehr.
